correctness.rationale: The actual adjacency has an r-dimensional zero-mode pair-antisymmetric component and symmetric quotient Q_r. At residue zero the eigenvalue-one sector has exactly one size-two spatial Jordan block; at other residues the irreducible quadratic sectors lift to Phi8 or Phi5. Temporal Jordan blocks have sizes two/four at minus one; exact modular fixed-space counts sum to three closed formulas and imply orders 36/24/60, all primitive periods and maximal-clock probabilities. A separate explicit intact-graph calculation gives orders 12/12/36. Two reproducible scripts replayed 1080 exact modular ranks and independently enumerated every r=2 state; all passed. Finite tests are corroboration; the written invariant-factor proof applies to all \(r\ge2\) and \(q=3^f\).
